title: The Loom MC
description: The Loom is a growing Minecraft network built for many playstyles, offering Survival, Creative, and Skyblock. We focus on a friendly community, active development, and listening closely to feedback to base the server around what players actually want.
body:
The Loom is a growing Minecraft network built for many playstyles, offering Survival, Creative, and Skyblock. We focus on a friendly community, active development, and listening closely to feedback to base the server around what players actually want.  The server is still new and evolving, so you may encounter bugs. but that also means you can give feedback and report bugs for rewards too!

we also now have a modded server, join the discord to get the pack for it
